item.text: {"action_type":"tool","claim_id":null,"hypothesis":"对每个正整数 n，∑_{k=1}^n k=n(n+1)/2。","parent_id":null,"tool_name":"induction_check","arguments_json":"{\"index\":\"n\",\"summation_index\":\"k\",\"start\":1,\"summand\":\"k\",\"formula\":\"n*(n+1)/2\",\"parameters\":{},\"domain\":{\"exclude_zero\":[]}}","evidence_ids":["EV002"],"decision_summary":"先核验整数和闭式这一辅助命题：n=1 时成立；从 n 到 n+1，闭式增量为 n+1。提交归纳证书检查，为随后核验 H001 的平方关系提供依据。","expected_information":"获得适用于所有整数 n≥1 的整数和闭式归纳核验结果；本轮不预先宣称证书成功或 H001 已证明。"}
